module_summary: Ethernet frame 1-to-N demultiplexer: at header accept a frame flag latches select and drop, steering one-hot header/payload valids to the chosen output through a broadcast-data skid-buffered AXI-Stream register.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Frame-in-progress state: set at header accept, cleared on last beat; gates header ready.

anchors.name: select_reg
anchors.why: Output port index latched per frame; steers one-hot header and payload valids.

anchors.name: drop_reg
anchors.why: Per-frame drop flag suppressing output valids while still consuming input.

anchors.name: select
anchors.why: External destination select sampled at frame start.

anchors.name: drop
anchors.why: External drop request sampled at frame start.

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: External enable gating input header and payload ready.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Input header valid; with ready starts a frame.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Input header ready when no frame active and no pending output header.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: One-hot output header valid steered to selected port.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Per-output header ready clearing header valid bits.

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Header fields (dest/src MAC, type) latched and broadcast to all outputs.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input payload data passed into output datapath.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Registered input payload ready during frame when output can accept or dropping.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input payload valid; drives steered internal valid and frame end detection.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload data broadcast to all outputs from output register.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: One-hot output payload valid selecting destination port.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Per-output payload ready deciding output/temp register transfers.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating acceptance into skid buffer.

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer data register holding a beat when output stalls.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable copying internal payload into output registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Load enable capturing internal payload into temp registers.

anchors.name: store_eth_payload_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable moving temp contents to output registers.

groups.name: Frame routing control
groups.description: Accepts header, latches select/drop, steers one-hot header valid and header fields.

groups.name: Payload steering
groups.description: Passes input payload, generates one-hot internal valid per selected output.

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output plus temp registers implementing registered AXI-Stream skid buffer.
